subject.title: fix(channels): progress drafts only for long tasks, with the model's own preamble as the status headline

question: Should progress mode promote sanitized model preambles to the default Discord and Telegram status headline and expose the three new optional GetReplyOptions lifecycle fields as supported plugin API?
rationale: The time-gate defect is well defined, but the headline default and additive plugin-facing API are lasting product and compatibility choices that tests cannot authorize.

options.title: Approve the current direction
options.body: Keep the no-config preamble headline and accept the three optional reply hooks as the supported channel/plugin boundary.

options.title: Land only the gate fix
options.body: Retain the purely time-based gate and deferred narration while removing the new headline behavior and plugin API expansion.

options.title: Redesign the boundary
options.body: Preserve the headline behavior but replace the public reply hooks with a narrower existing or internal lifecycle contract before merge.

recommendation.title: Approve the current direction
recommendation.body: Keep the no-config preamble headline and accept the three optional reply hooks as the supported channel/plugin boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history shows direct ownership of the issue, implementation series, assignment, and maintainer-labeled product direction.
